In our twin, the asphalt base texture was too dark (`#25282d`) and the headlight intensity/falloff was too weak, leaving the road in Frames 4–5 and the sidewalk in Frame 6 overly dark.
   - In Frames 1–3, the foreground-left concrete (`u = 0.0..0.32, v = 0.65..0.85`), the circular utility cover (`u = 0.07, v = 0.77`), the diagonal crack groove, and the left concrete curb lip (`u = 0.14..0.36, v = 0.65..0.68`) were too dim.
